approach.title: approach
approach.text: I see every new programming language as an opportunity, not a barrier. From TypeScript to COBOL — every environment has its own logic, and I adapt. My work is driven by rigor, clean code, and a deep understanding of the business context.

background.title: background
background.text: I practiced law in Brazil for five years, specializing in labor and business law. After moving to France, I pivoted into tech: intensive full stack training, a startup internship, then a mainframe specialization. Today I'm a COBOL consultant in Strasbourg, working on mission-critical systems in banking and insurance — while still building modern web projects on the side.

beyondCode.title: beyond code
beyondCode.text: Outside of development, I love cinema, running, dogs, and cooking. These passions keep me balanced and continuously inspired.
